entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A storm-mage planeswalker native to Ravnica and guildmaster of the Izzet League, married to Tomik Vrona.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of mage-scientists led by Niv-Mizzet, which Ral came to lead.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The ancient dragon guildmaster of the Izzet League who resurrected after being killed in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Tomik Vrona
entities.description: An Orzhov property lawyer and Ral's husband.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon who employed young Ral and later invaded Ravnica.

entities.name: Elias
entities.description: A young poet who was Ral's lover in his youth.

entities.name: Harith
entities.description: Ral's lover on an unidentified plane, whom he betrayed.

entities.name: Skreeg
entities.description: Ral's goblin attendant.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of the Undercity that clashed with Ral's team and later fought Bolas.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepath planeswalker who became Ravnica's first Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: Azor's failsafe on the Forum of Azor, activated only if every guild took part, in case the Guildpact was disrupted.

entities.name: Melek
entities.description: A weird created as the Izzet's ideal champion for the maze, whom Ral murdered.

entities.name: Living Guildpact
entities.description: The power empowered by the Supreme Verdict and held first by Jace, later granted to Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker and Golgari leader who killed Isperia and later joined the fight against Bolas.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who reported seeing Tezzeret on Kaladesh.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who served Bolas and beat Ral on Alara.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A ghost-assassin planeswalker who killed the Obzedat and became Orzhov guildmaster.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: The Orzhov leader whom Tomik serves.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: The Azorius guildmaster killed by Vraska.

entities.name: Interplanar Beacon
entities.description: The beacon Ral built to call planeswalkers to Ravnica, which Bolas used as a trap.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Bolas's artifact that trapped planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: A Rakdos ally who died helping Ral and was resurrected as a blood witch.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: An Azorius figure possessed by Bolas's magic and freed by Ral.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: A newly ignited planeswalker whom Ral befriended.

entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: A Gateless street urchin who helped explain the situation to Teyo.

entities.name: Maree
entities.description: An Izzet chamberlain who worked with Ral and later called a vote of no confidence against him.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A God-Eternal driven off by Ral and incinerated by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demon lord leading the Rakdos cult, who knocked Ral out on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who repaired the leylines in the Guildpact ritual.

entities.name: Wanderer
entities.description: A planeswalker who tracked Tezzeret with Ral and was later desparked.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane where Tezzeret's fortress stood in Esper.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: The central dryad of Trostani, who brainwashed citizens to kill those she saw as profiting from the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: The detective presiding over the murder case.

entities.name: Kylox
entities.description: An Izzet member killed in the string of murders.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Oko's son whom Ral brought along as bodyguard on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Kellan's father who raided the vault Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The outlaw plane where Ral set up Omenpath relays.

entities.name: Bloomburrow
entities.description: The animal-folk plane where Ral is turned into an otterfolk.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: An adventurer whose party Ral joins on Bloomburrow.

entities.name: Helga
entities.description: A timid, prophetic frogfolk in Mabel's party.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where Ral was born.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Bolas's invasion of Ravnica.

events.summary: Ral's mother dies after a long decline and the thirteen-year-old leaves his father.
events.quote: it had only taken a few months for the thirteen-year-old to abandon his drunken lout of a father and strike out on his own

events.summary: Ral catches Elias with another man; the shock ignites his spark and he leaves Ravnica.
events.quote: The shock ignited his planeswalker's spark

events.summary: Ral robs and betrays his teacher and Harith, builds a small imperium, then returns to Ravnica when Bolas comes to collect his debt.
events.quote: Ral betrayed Harith as well and left with all the loot

events.summary: Ral's team clashes with the Golgari Swarm in the Undercity and he channels a leyline through his gauntlets, blasting the tunnels.
events.quote: funneling the entire energy of a leyline through his elemental gauntlets

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet takes Ral off the project and orders him to find Jace.
events.quote: Ral was to find Jace Beleren.

events.summary: Niv reveals the maze was Azor's failsafe for the Guildpact and sends Ral to share the research with other guilds.
events.quote: It was a failsafe in the event the Guildpact was ever disrupted.

events.summary: Ral absorbs the weird Melek into his gauntlet, killing the rightful champion, and declares himself Izzet maze runner.
events.quote: Ral absorbed the weird's essence into his gauntlet, effectively murdering the rightful champion

events.summary: Ral forces Jace to tell Emmara the truth, but Jace escapes with illusions.
events.quote: Jace used his illusions to escape Ral's justice

events.summary: Jace unites the champions' minds, triggering the Supreme Verdict and becoming Ravnica's first Living Guildpact.
events.quote: empowered Jace as Ravnica's first Living Guildpact

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet reveals he knew Ral is a planeswalker and that Bolas plans to invade; Ral is promised control of the Izzet.
events.quote: In return, Ral was promised control of the Izzet League .

events.summary: Ral stages a Golgari attack on Orzhova, and Kaya kills the Obzedat and becomes guildmaster.
events.quote: Kaya involuntarily became the new guildmaster using the Orzhov magic rules.

events.summary: Vraska kills Isperia, causing the guild summit to fail.
events.quote: That night, Vraska killed Isperia , causing the summit to fail.

events.summary: Dovin Baan sabotages Ral's great machine, and Ral activates the Interplanar Beacon after defeating Vraska at the cost of Hekara's life.
events.quote: At the cost of Hekara's life, Ral was able to defeat Vraska and free Lavinia.

events.summary: Bolas brings the Immortal Sun to Ravnica, trapping the planeswalkers.
events.quote: Bolas brought the Immortal Sun to Ravnica, trapping the planeswalkers there.

events.summary: Ral drains the Beacon and blasts off God-Eternal Kefnet's arm with the stored power.
events.quote: blasting the god's arm off

events.summary: Vraska pledges the Golgari to the fight against Bolas.
events.quote: Vraska pledged the Golgari to the fight against Bolas

events.summary: Tomik reunites with Ral and Hekara is resurrected as a blood witch to lead the Rakdos against Bolas.
events.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet is resurrected with the Living Guildpact's power and incinerates Kefnet.
events.quote: Niv was able to completely incinerate Kefnet in a torrent of flame

events.summary: After the battle, Ral and Tomik reunite and kiss; Ral volunteers to capture Tezzeret as penance.
events.quote: Ral volunteered to capture Tezzeret as his penance.

events.summary: Ral and the Wanderer find Tezzeret on Alara; Tezzeret beats Ral and gives him his damaged arm as proof of a kill.
events.quote: Tezzeret showed mercy and gave Ral his damaged etherium arm to provide proof of a kill

events.summary: Maree calls a vote of no confidence but Ral keeps his position; he and Tomik later marry.
events.quote: Ral and Tomik were married during the springtime on Ravnica.

events.summary: Ral defeats the Phyrexian attack led by Vraska with a sonic method against the glistening oil.
events.quote: managed to win the battle

events.summary: Oba reveals she was behind the murders, including Kylox's, and attacks the guild leaders; Kaya and Etrata defeat her.
events.quote: He was rescued after Kaya and Etrata defeated Oba.

events.summary: On Thunder Junction Ral sees Vraska among Oko's gang and is knocked out by Rakdos.
events.quote: This was enough of an opening for Rakdos to knock him out in one blow.

events.summary: Oko's benefactor is revealed to be Jace, who takes a child from the vault and vanishes with Vraska.
events.quote: the benefactor revealed himself to be Jace

events.summary: Ral follows Jace's aether trail to Bloomburrow and is transformed into an otterfolk.
events.quote: his appearance had been changed into that of an otterfolk

events.summary: Helga recites a prophecy before Ral leaves Bloomburrow.
events.quote: The kings in the dark will return, The mage in blue will bring about the end.
